analyses.groupDescription: Analysis done using a modified Andersen-Gill model with a robust variance. The model included treatment group, ATTR amyloidosis disease type, New York Heart Association (NYHA) class, age group, and log-transformed baseline N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) as covariates.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: All-cause mortality and recurrent CV events (CV hospitalizations and urgent HF visits) were compared between treatment groups using a modified Andersen-Gill model with a robust variance. All-cause mortality included heart transplantation and LVAD placement events along with deaths; recurrent CV events included CV hospitalizations and urgent HF visits. The number of participants with at least one CV event or all-cause mortality event have been reported here. No imputation was done for participants who dropped out early for the primary analysis of this composite outcome endpoint.

groups.description: Participants in the DB period received vutrisiran matching placebo, SC injection, q3M for up to 36 months.
groups.title: DB Period: Placebo

groups.description: Participants in the DB period received vutrisiran, 25 mg, SC injection, q3M for up to 36 months.
groups.title: DB Period: Vutrisiran

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: FAS included all participants who were randomized and received any amount of study drug (vutrisiran or placebo).
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Composite Endpoint of All-Cause Mortality and Recurrent Cardiovascular (CV) Events (CV Hospitalizations and Urgent Heart Failure [HF] Visits) in the Overall Population
